question: Is price calibrated conditional on having filled, and does any miscalibration survive out of sample?
evidence_class: L5 POLYMARKET HISTORY -- not PMUS, not our own fills
what_is_missing: BTC spot at the decision timestamp
fees and credited incentives on L5 fills
quotes that rested UNFILLED (only fills are recorded)

calibration_fill_conditioned.labels: alpha = P(won|px) - px, measured on ACTUAL fills, so fill-conditioned adverse selection is already inside it

per_bucket_sign_replication.note: the mid range 0.40-0.60 flips; the extremes 0.15 and 0.80-0.95 replicate

maker_vs_taker.labels: from l5_actions, which carries mt. The 694k fill set does not.
maker_vs_taker.unresolved: the action-level magnitude (+0.0347) is ~4x the fill-level one (+0.0082). Both agree in sign and significance; the discrepancy is NOT resolved.

our_own_realized_cross_check.labels: our 44 venue-settled stranded legs with a measurable basis. This is REALIZED money, not replay.
our_own_realized_cross_check.verdict: DOES NOT CONFIRM. Our favourite region LOST and our longshot region WON -- the opposite sign to L5 -- on 2 and 5 legs respectively. Underpowered to the point of carrying no information.

verdict: A prospective rule IS supported by L5 history: condition the maker quote on PRICE LEVEL, which is known at decision time. It replicates out of sample at the extremes. It CANNOT be promoted, for three reasons stated separately: (1) it is Polymarket evidence and we hold ZERO PMUS fill-conditioned outcomes by price level; (2) it is DIRECTIONAL, not pair-based, and the executor has no authorized action class for holding a directional position to settlement; (3) the two L5 datasets disagree 4x on magnitude.
